name: dropshadow-chains-units
document:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Left: named results. Middle: bbox units under unequal scaling.
       Right: SourceAlpha and an explicit return to SourceGraphic. -->
  <defs>
    <filter id="chain" x="-80%" y="-80%" width="280%" height="280%">
      <feDropShadow in="SourceGraphic" dx="12" dy="0" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#06b6d4" result="cyan"/>
      <feDropShadow in="cyan" dx="0" dy="12" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#e11d48" result="red"/>
      <feDropShadow in="red" dx="-8" dy="-5" stdDeviation="2 5" flood-color="#7c3aed" flood-opacity=".6"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="relative" x="-80%" y="-80%" width="280%" height="280%" primitiveUnits="objectBoundingBox">
      <feDropShadow dx=".2" dy=".3" stdDeviation=".07 .025" flood-color="#2563eb" flood-opacity=".7"/>
      <feDropShadow dx="-.15" dy="0" stdDeviation="0 .06" flood-color="#f97316" flood-opacity=".7"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="alpha" x="-70%" y="-70%" width="240%" height="240%">
      <feDropShadow in="SourceAlpha" dx="10" dy="8" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#e11d48"/>
      <feDropShadow dx="-8" dy="-8" stdDeviation="1 4" flood-color="#06b6d4" flood-opacity=".7"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="reset" x="-70%" y="-70%" width="240%" height="240%">
      <feDropShadow dx="25" dy="0" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="red" result="discarded"/>
      <feDropShadow in="SourceGraphic" dx="-8" dy="8" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#2563eb"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <g transform="translate(90 85) rotate(-12)" filter="url(#chain)">
    <path d="M0-38L12-12L40-10L20 9L25 36L0 23L-25 36L-20 9L-40-10L-12-12Z" fill="#fbbf24"/>
    <circle cx="32" cy="28" r="12" fill="#f97316"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(290 92) rotate(15) scale(1.3 .65)">
    <rect x="-42" y="-40" width="84" height="80" rx="12" fill="#86efac" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="6" filter="url(#relative)"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(460 85) rotate(-20)">
    <path d="M-25-30H25V30H-25Z" fill="#fbbf24" opacity=".8" filter="url(#alpha)"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="550" cy="110" r="19" fill="#fbbf24" filter="url(#reset)"/>
</svg>

name: dropshadow-deep-nesting
document:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Five filter levels; shared definitions, negative scales and nested opacity. -->
  <defs>
    <filter id="soft" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%">
      <feDropShadow dx="4" dy="5" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#1e3a8a" flood-opacity=".45"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="edge" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%">
      <feDropShadow dx="-3" dy="2" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#db2777" flood-opacity=".6"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <g transform="translate(95 90)" filter="url(#soft)">
    <g transform="rotate(-15)" filter="url(#edge)">
      <g transform="scale(1.1 .8)" filter="url(#soft)" opacity=".85">
        <g transform="skewX(12)" filter="url(#edge)">
          <path d="M-40-35H30L45 5L15 35H-40Z" fill="#fbbf24" stroke="#92400e" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#soft)"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(300 90) scale(-1 1)" filter="url(#soft)" opacity=".75">
    <g transform="rotate(20)" filter="url(#edge)">
      <g transform="scale(.8 1.15)" filter="url(#soft)">
        <g transform="translate(6 -5)" filter="url(#edge)">
          <circle r="34" fill="#67e8f9" filter="url(#soft)"/>
          <rect x="-35" y="5" width="30" height="30" fill="#a78bfa" filter="url(#edge)"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(500 85) rotate(12)" filter="url(#soft)">
    <g transform="scale(1.2 .75)" filter="url(#edge)">
      <g transform="rotate(-35)" filter="url(#soft)" opacity=".7">
        <g transform="skewY(15)" filter="url(#edge)">
          <path d="M0-40L38 25H-38Z" fill="#86efac" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="4" filter="url(#soft)"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>

name: dropshadow-clipping-masks
document:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Left: a hard filter boundary. Middle: clip after nested filters.
       Right: a mask and group opacity after nested shadows. -->
  <defs>
    <filter id="tight" filterUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="25" y="30" width="110" height="115">
      <feDropShadow dx="22" dy="16" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#7c3aed" flood-opacity=".8"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="wide" x="-80%" y="-80%" width="260%" height="260%">
      <feDropShadow dx="10" dy="10" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#0f172a" flood-opacity=".6"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="child" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
      <feDropShadow dx="-8" dy="5" stdDeviation="3 0" flood-color="#0891b2" flood-opacity=".8"/>
    </filter>
    <clipPath id="cut"><rect x="-48" y="-40" width="85" height="95" rx="12"/></clipPath>
    <mask id="bands" maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="-65" y="-65" width="150" height="150">
      <rect x="-65" y="-65" width="150" height="150" fill="white"/>
      <rect x="5" y="-65" width="15" height="150" fill="black"/>
    </mask>
  </defs>
  <g transform="translate(8 8)" filter="url(#tight)">
    <rect x="35" y="40" width="85" height="80" rx="8" fill="#fb7185" filter="url(#child)"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(285 88) rotate(18)" filter="url(#wide)" clip-path="url(#cut)">
    <rect x="-45" y="-35" width="90" height="75" rx="10" fill="#fbbf24" filter="url(#child)"/>
    <circle cx="25" cy="30" r="25" fill="#a78bfa"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(495 88) rotate(-12)" filter="url(#wide)" mask="url(#bands)" opacity=".65">
    <rect x="-40" y="-35" width="80" height="70" rx="12" fill="#86efac" filter="url(#child)"/>
    <g transform="translate(20 25) rotate(35)" filter="url(#child)">
      <rect x="-25" y="-18" width="50" height="36" fill="#fb7185" stroke="#9f1239" stroke-width="4"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>

name: dropshadow-nested-transforms
document:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Each coloured silhouette has its own shadow; the enclosing group casts another. -->
  <defs>
    <filter id="outer" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="240%" height="240%">
      <feDropShadow dx="8" dy="10" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#172554" flood-opacity=".55"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="inner" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="240%" height="240%">
      <feDropShadow dx="-5" dy="5" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#0891b2" flood-opacity=".8"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="sharp" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="240%" height="240%">
      <feDropShadow dx="5" dy="-6" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#e11d48" flood-opacity=".6"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <g transform="translate(80 80) rotate(-18)" filter="url(#outer)">
    <rect x="-38" y="-35" width="76" height="70" rx="12" fill="#fbbf24" filter="url(#inner)"/>
    <g transform="translate(27 20) rotate(35)" filter="url(#sharp)">
      <path d="M-24-18H24V18H-24Z" fill="#fb7185" stroke="#9f1239" stroke-width="4"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(295 85) skewX(22) scale(1.25 .7)" filter="url(#outer)" opacity=".75">
    <circle r="42" fill="#a78bfa" filter="url(#inner)"/>
    <g transform="rotate(30) translate(30 20)" filter="url(#sharp)">
      <rect x="-22" y="-18" width="44" height="36" fill="#67e8f9" stroke="#155e75" stroke-width="5"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(515 92) scale(-1 .9) rotate(24)" filter="url(#outer)">
    <path d="M-45-35L42-20L15 38L-35 25Z" fill="#86efac" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="5" filter="url(#inner)"/>
    <g transform="translate(12 -12) scale(.8 1.2)" filter="url(#sharp)">
      <circle r="17" fill="#fda4af"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
